d: Italy has rebuked Ukraine over its November 22 attacks on Russian vessels in Libyan waters, warning Kyiv against expanding the war to new areas. Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani called the strikes a mistake, saying Rome had received no warning and that the operation violated Libya's sovereignty. Ukrainian forces targeted a Russian corvette in Benghazi and the cargo vessel Angara, with Kyiv defending the maritime drone strikes as acts of self-defence.
